problem_statement: A six-times daily GitHub Actions cron has missed or materially delayed slots. The immutable first-seen Base WETH/cbBTC ledger contains 22 captures and only 3 contiguous timely paired 4h bars as of the 2026-11-01 12:49:45Z capture (actual source file and audit). No 194-bar causal warmup or execution cost proof.

reliability_change.backup_goal: Increase independent opportunities for a timely source capture within one hour after the UTC 4h close; two schedules share one GitHub Actions service and therefore do NOT prove scheduler independence.
reliability_change.slot_guard: At actual runtime wall-clock, compute last completed 4h Base slot. If already exactly observed, unconflicted and both-asset paired within 3600 seconds of close, skip a duplicate. Otherwise capture once read-only at actual clock time; never assign cron time as first-seen.
reliability_change.evidence_on_skip: Preserve exact slot decision JSON as CI artifact even when no market source added. Never count skip as valid bar or paper day.
reliability_change.evidence_on_capture: Preserve in-run strict NO-GO audit and source SHA; persist source+financial refusal together only if verified.
reliability_change.failure_handling: Any malformed or contradictory saved capture fails closed rather than being silently ignored. GitHub schedule can still be delayed/dropped, and an external independent timer is not introduced in this change.

negative_controls: late matching source => capture; old timestamp remains unchanged
no completed bar => skip rather than fabricated candle
near 4h rollover => target last completed bar not nominal schedule
outcome_contract: Do not call this fix profitable or qualifying. Report actual clock coverage over the next genuinely elapsed slots and GitHub CI result; retain exact adverse, missing, or late evidence.
